verdict_text:
YES

The script drops blocks 2/5/8, maps the survivors in original order onto 0..8 (so no rename can collide with a surviving key), copies the 4 non-block tensors untouched, and preserves values/shapes/dtypes by reusing the loaded tensors. Both required assertions — contiguous layer set `{0..8}` (which also rules out any residual block 9/10/11) and a 121-tensor total — run before `save_file`, so a failure exits non-zero with no output written.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
